title: Microsoft Teams: Android device management moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the description of the general service's supported clouds incorrectly includes Office 365 operated by 21Vianet by saying only DoD is excluded. Microsoft excludes both. The transition dates, control paths, licensing prerequisites and cloud-specific Admin Agent requirements are otherwise supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft is transitioning Teams Android device management from TAC to PMP.
claims.quote: we are transitioning Teams Android device management from the Teams admin center (TAC) to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal (PMP).

claims.claim: The portal unifies management of Windows and Android Teams devices.
claims.quote: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal.
